set.body: Use the bounded compact document route for native plan/input/ledger/result storage with explicit physical-format versioning. Keep20Mcells/1Mstructuralmetadata rows/512entries/256MiB unchanged, legacyJSONrefusals unchanged, and all scientific canonical digests and records intact. New-format byte identity differs by design; old-file read compatibility and export/scientific identity must be proven. Do not merely relabel row counters or expand a compressed archive into old massive JSON.
set.title: Integrate versioned compact native archive storage and legacy reading
